dct_description_sm: Western Sahara administrative level 0-1 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 1 level: - Admin 1: 4 Dates associated with this dataset: - 19 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 05 April 2021: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 08 April 2021: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 08 April 2021: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-romena). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).
